visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a grey blazer, holds a black product box labeled 'TIME PHOBIA' in front of a neutral-toned, vertically textured wall. She smiles and points at the box while looking directly at the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a tight close-up of her face as she uses a lip gloss applicator to apply a reddish-pink liquid to her lips. She looks at her reflection or the camera with a satisfied expression. (3) She continues applying the gloss, moving the applicator carefully. Her skin looks dewy and glowing under the bright indoor lighting. (4) The camera remains in a close-up as she finishes the application and moves her head slightly, letting the light catch the gloss on her lips. She looks upwards briefly before focusing back on the camera. (5) She presses her lips together, then separates them to show the finish. She has a bright, engaged expression. (6) She holds a clear rectangular plastic sheet up to her mouth and presses her glossy lips against it in a firm kissing motion. (7) She pulls the plastic sheet away and holds it up for the camera to see. She opens her mouth in wide-eyed surprise, pointing at the sheet. (8) She brings the plastic sheet closer to the lens, demonstrating that no color has transferred onto it. She continues to look amazed, with her mouth slightly open. (9) She holds the small black lip product bottle next to her face, smiling broadly and gesturing towards her lips and the camera, concluding the demonstration.
